note: PUB-7 launch evidence: for each key or secret the public service depends on, where the replace-it-fast procedure is written down and where it was rehearsed. Names only, never values. A rehearsal is a test that changes the key in the local harness and proves people stay connected (or are signed out on purpose); it is never a production rotation. The readiness report checks that each procedure file exists and each rehearsal test name is really in its test file.
